specification_compliance: The reviewers listed no findings, so there were no verification records to write. I spot-checked several invariants against the code in the worktree.

I8: addons/knowledge/app/routers/notes.py:185-186 calls _declare_unverified only when body.origin == "ask_answer". notes.py:62-80 treats 409 as accepted and maps any other InternalAPIError or httpx.HTTPError to 502. So the route either answers 201 after core accepts, answers 201 with a ruling the viewer already made, or answers non-2xx. This matches I8.

I9: notes.py:82 sets trust_declared_at only after the declaration succeeds or returns 409. trust_declaration.py:50-58 selects only rows where origin == 'ask_answer' and trust_declared_at IS NULL. trust_declaration.py:65-89 marks a row only on success or 409 and leaves every other failure NULL so the next start retries it. main.py:166 runs the pass with asyncio.create_task after startup, so it does not block /health, and main.py:135-142 swallows non-cancel exceptions.

I10: database.py:161-177 adds a nullable DATETIME column with no default and does nothing if the column already exists or the table is missing. It is called last in init_schema (database.py:188). No row data is touched.

I2: file_question.py:148-180 sets the budget to max_chars // 2. It removes markers before counting and repeats the removal until nothing changes (file_question.py:183-188), so a nested marker like [[1]1] is also removed. It walks turns from newest to oldest and stops at the first turn that does not fit, so a kept turn is never older than a dropped one. When the newest turn alone is too long, it is cut to fit the budget, question first.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The startup pass retries a 404 (a trashed or purged note) at every start and logs it only at debug level. The module docstring at trust_declaration.py:5-7 says this is deliberate, and I9 allows it.
regression_risks: notes.py commits the note_origins row before declaring the trust tier. If the declaration fails, the client receives a 502 even though the note exists. The detail message says so, and I8 allows a non-2xx answer in this case.
test_coverage: I did not inspect the test files. Coverage of I1 to I11 was not assessed in this pass.
